resources.string: Hi! I\'m Peri, your friend. I\'m here to lend you a hand.
Let Peri read your message alerts
Oh dear, this phone can\'t understand speech. You can still read what I say here.

I\'m going to ask you for a few permissions so I can look after you: to understand you, to know who your family is, to warn you during a call, to call and send messages only when you say yes and, just in an emergency, to share where you are. Everything stays on your phone.
To warn you before you pick up a call from a number that isn\'t in your contacts, I\'ll ask to check incoming calls. I only see the number: I never block or listen to your calls.
